review.summary: The Phoenix improvement proposals present a comprehensive set of enhancements aimed at refining data contracts, calibration, risk assessment, and decision support mechanisms. Each proposal adheres to the constraints of not fabricating evidence and maintaining the fixed-24m OOS gate. The focus is on maximizing expected information gain while minimizing risks associated with implementation.
top_technical_reasons: Proposals are designed to enhance data integrity and reliability.
Improvements focus on reducing risks associated with model calibration and decision-making.
Each proposal includes a clear metric gate to ensure performance validation.
review.candidate_safety: High, as all proposals are subject to stringent validation against empirical baselines before any production promotion.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Adding source reliability scores will improve data quality assessments.
next_experiments.change: Implement a scoring system for data sources based on historical accuracy.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Measure the impact on OOS Brier and log-loss metrics.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will provide insights into how source reliability affects overall model performance.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Validating timezone normalization will reduce discrepancies in data ingestion.
next_experiments.change: Introduce a validation step for timezone normalization during data ingestion.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Evaluate the reduction in data discrepancies post-implementation.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: Understanding the impact of timezone normalization will help in refining data processing workflows.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Detecting duplicate observations will enhance data integrity.
next_experiments.change: Develop a system to identify and flag duplicate observations across providers.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Assess the reduction in data redundancy and its effect on model accuracy.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will clarify the extent of data duplication issues and their impact on model performance.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Storing corporate-action adjustment provenance will improve transparency.
next_experiments.change: Implement a tracking system for corporate-action adjustments.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Monitor the effect on model interpretability and user trust.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will provide insights into how provenance affects user confidence in model outputs.

next_experiments.hypothesis: Adding a human review queue for disputed facts will enhance data validation.
next_experiments.change: Create a queue for human review of disputed data points.
next_experiments.metric_gate: Evaluate the accuracy of resolved disputes and its impact on model performance.
next_experiments.why_it_is_informative: This will help assess the effectiveness of human oversight in data validation processes.

data_or_label_risks: Potential for incomplete data if source reliability is not accurately assessed.
Risk of introducing bias if timezone normalization is improperly validated.
Duplicate observations may still affect model performance if not effectively detected.
Lack of transparency in corporate actions could lead to mistrust in model outputs.
Human review processes may introduce delays or inconsistencies in data validation.

proposals.title: Add source reliability scores per field
proposals.change: Implement a scoring system for data sources based on historical accuracy.
proposals.rationale: Enhancing data quality assessments through reliable source scoring.
proposals.implementation_sketch: Develop a scoring algorithm that evaluates sources based on past performance metrics.
proposals.metric_gate: No production promotion unless fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss beat the empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.

proposals.title: Validate timezone normalization at ingestion
proposals.change: Introduce a validation step for timezone normalization during data ingestion.
proposals.rationale: To reduce discrepancies in data ingestion and improve overall data quality.
proposals.implementation_sketch: Create a validation module that checks and corrects timezone discrepancies.
proposals.metric_gate: No production promotion unless fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss beat the empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.

proposals.title: Detect duplicate observations across providers
proposals.change: Develop a system to identify and flag duplicate observations.
proposals.rationale: To enhance data integrity and reduce redundancy.
proposals.implementation_sketch: Implement a deduplication algorithm that scans incoming data for duplicates.
proposals.metric_gate: No production promotion unless fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss beat the empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.

proposals.title: Store corporate-action adjustment provenance
proposals.change: Implement a tracking system for corporate-action adjustments.
proposals.rationale: To improve transparency and accountability in data handling.
proposals.implementation_sketch: Create a database schema to log all corporate-action adjustments with timestamps.
proposals.metric_gate: No production promotion unless fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss beat the empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.

proposals.title: Add human review queue for disputed facts
proposals.change: Create a queue for human review of disputed data points.
proposals.rationale: To enhance data validation and ensure accuracy.
proposals.implementation_sketch: Develop a workflow for flagging disputed data and routing it to human reviewers.
proposals.metric_gate: No production promotion unless fixed-24m OOS Brier and log-loss beat the empirical baseline at 6/12/18/24 anchors.
